gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: UI Guide
UI Layout & 3-Step Workflow
Mode tabs, dual slots, list rows & Sanctum console
Five clear zones let you inscribe or cleanse any item in three quick steps:
Switch top tabs between Inscribe & Cleanse; open/close this guide without dropping items.
Place target gear, book, or base item in the Top Slot and primary reagent below.
Click any lit row on the left; secondary bundle items pull straight from your inventory.
Hover cost icons to compare all reagent options; hover XP badges for exact discount math.
Shelves
Three-Track Bookshelf System
7x5x7 obstruction-free scan, Wooden curve & Master Tomes
Scans +/-%s horizontal & +/-%s vertical blocks (7x5x7); blocks between never obstruct.
Track 1 [Blank Gear]: Wooden shelves alone inscribe blank gear up to ceil(MAX/2).
Track 2 [Upgrades]: Once rank I is present, 0-%s Wooden shelves unlock up to MAX.
Track 3 [Master Tomes]: Books inside Chiseled Shelves unlock 1..k & Treasures directly!
Live Sync
Shelf and book changes update open menus live within 1 second.

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Book Loop
Book Upgrades & Delta Credit
0-material Combine, single-book Research & step credit
Two routes raise Master Tomes, and upgrades deduct prior costs.
Combine (0 Items): matching books in Top & Bottom Slots at 0.6x Full XP (above Tome floor); leaves 1 Depleted Tome.
Research (1 Book): book in Top Slot + reagent or 1x Arcane Catalyst below at 1.4x Full XP.
Delta Credit: upgrading existing ranks deducts prior items, and costs 1-2L with a Tome.
One Tome, Infinite Gear
Store one MAX Tome in a Chiseled Shelf to craft gear forever at 1–3L!

Cleanse
Cleanse, Step-Down & Curse Purge
Free wipe, 1-tier step-down, targeted strip & vanilla curse purge
Open the teal Cleanse tab to modify enchanted gear or books cleanly:
Disenchant All (0 Items): strips non-curses, spawns XP orbs & turns emptied books into Depleted Tomes.
Step-Down (0 Items): lowers 1 rank & refunds step XP orbs; rank I solo book becomes Depleted Tome.
Targeted Strip: on multi-trait gear, spends items + Lv.4-10 (-1~3L) to remove 1 trait cleanly.
Curse Purge: spends Golden Apple+Lapis / Echo+Lapis / 1x Catalyst & 12L Full XP (up to -35% base).
